findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 47 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): nav.sticky.top-20 1416px | ul.grid.border-t 1320px | li.flex.gap-4 440px | li.flex.gap-4 440px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Prefer a filled surface or no box.
One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 90 characters per line.

findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 60px (4.2vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Marque a sua consulta" (screen 10, 100% hidden); "fisio4you" (screen 12, 50% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Little motion: 14 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Give every section an entrance for its parts (not one fade of the whole block) and add one moving picture: a looping clip or a slow move on a photograph.

findings.message: 4 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 768px: "Ecografia e técnicas ecoguiadas" → 3 lines (4 words, 36.2px); "Ginásio de reabilitação com 100 m²" → 3 lines (6 words, 36.2px); "Crioterapia (banheira de gelo) e sauna" → 3 lines (6 words, 36.2px); "Marque a sua consulta" → 3 lines (4 words, 45.5px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 32px or less.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("Fisioterapia Musculoesquelética") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.

findings.message: With reduced motion requested, 2 text block(s) on the first screen stay invisible: "Fisioterapia Musculoesquelética", "Fisioterapia Dermatofuncional"
findings.fix: Put every hidden starting state inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); the reduced page is the finished page (references/motion.md §8).
